plugins.name: battlemap-mcp
plugins.description: Build battle maps in a running Dungeondraft: the map tools (walls, floors, terrain, lighting, objects, screenshots) plus skills for art direction, composition and review. Needs Dungeondraft 1.2.0.1 and the bridge mod, which your assistant can install. Use instead of the companion download, not with it.
